title: Effective stability for Hamiltonian PDEs vanishing spectral gaps
summary: This paper studies the effective stability of nearly integrable Hamiltonian PDEs with asymptotically vanishing spectral gaps ($0 < α< 1$). Under a unified high-low frequency decomposition, we construct a modified block clustering partition based on Bourgain's ideas. By leveraging the vanishing of spectral gaps to suppress high-frequency resonant contributions, the overall non-resonance property is maintained under high-regularity weights.
